VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design, making big-screen experiences more accessible.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple publishes technical specifications for third-party motion controllers for its Vision Pro, supporting expanded accessory development.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, a new shooter title returning to its 2024 era, launching on Meta Quest and PC VR.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve releases a new store page for its upcoming Steam Frame headset, hinting at a launch for its standalone VR device.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirms ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, with a potential reveal at the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game featuring hand tracking, is now available for free on Meta Quest.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging theft of trade secrets related to AI hardware development.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, marking a significant update for its AI models.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature to label ads created or edited using AI across its platforms, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program that incentivizes homeowners to host AI data center compute units in their residences.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following backlash.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down ChatGPT Atlas, its browser designed for automated tasks, less than a year after its launch.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's group agrees to purchase the Seattle Seahawks for a record $9.612 billion, requiring him to divest his 49ers stake.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Signs point to Aaron Donald potentially unretiring as he resumes workouts at the Rams' facility.

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Chicago Bears have signed third-round tight end Sam Roush, completing their draft class signings.

NFL.title: Daniel Jones is "cleared to do everything" and "feeling good"
NFL.summary: Daniel Jones is cleared for all activities and feels optimistic about his performance during the offseason program.

NFL.title: Sean Payton predicts there will be more grass fields "where it's possible"
NFL.summary: Sean Payton advocates for more grass fields in the NFL, highlighting the ongoing debate over turf versus natural grass.

NFL.title: Colts want to "find ways to take some of that workload" off Jonathan Taylor
NFL.summary: The Colts aim to reduce Jonathan Taylor's workload, acknowledging the need for a more balanced approach to his carries.
